**Evaluating combat strategy**

I need to decide on my action. Attacking Sheoldred seems like a priority even though I only have five lands. I might think about playing the hacker before combat, as it can use ninjutsu if I attack. But I don’t have a land in hand, and I want to attack—Sheoldred is close to being taken out. The opponent has four mana and no blockers, which could mean they’re vulnerable to burn. I need to consider the right approach here!**Analyzing combat choices**

If I use ninjutsu with Hacker, I deal 4 damage but then I lose pressure and card draw. I could attack Sheoldred first and then return her, allowing Hacker to deal 2 damage and possibly draw a card if I enter my turn. The opponent would be at 6 life, but I need to consider that keeping Sheoldred in hand makes her vulnerable to direct burn, especially since they have 4 mana. I need to think through the implications of all these plotted strategies!**Setting a combat plan**

The opponent has 4 Mountains, which makes a Fireblast potentially very dangerous if they draw more copies. Their deck is unknown in terms of burn spells. Sheoldred can be lethal in 2 attacks, so there might not be a reason to cast the Hacker. I should consider passing during the attack phase. I need to answer and set a clear plan, maybe to attack with Sheoldred while keeping Hacker for ninjutsu. It’s time to think strategically!

YOUR DECKLIST (you know your own deck's contents; only the draw order is hidden): 3x Faithless Looting, 4x Fiery Temper, 3x Fireblast, 4x Grab the Prize, 3x Guttersnipe, 4x Highway Robbery, 4x Kessig Flamebreather, 4x Lava Dart, 4x Lightning Bolt, 19x Mountain, 4x Sneaky Snacker, 4x Voldaren Epicure
YOUR CARDS (what each card in your deck does):
  Faithless Looting {R} — Draw two cards, then discard two cards.\nFlashback {2}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
  Fiery Temper {1}{R}{R} — Fiery Temper deals 3 damage to any target.\nMadness {R} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)
  Fireblast {4}{R}{R} — You may sacrifice two Mountains rather than pay this spell's mana cost.\nFireblast deals 4 damage to any target.
  Grab the Prize {1}{R} — As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.\nDraw two cards. If the discarded card wasn't a land card, Grab the Prize deals 2 damage to each opponent.
  Guttersnipe {2}{R} — Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Guttersnipe deals 2 damage to each opponent.
  Highway Robbery {1}{R} — You may discard a card or sacrifice a land. If you do, draw two cards.\nPlot {1}{R} (You may pay {1}{R} and exile this card from your hand. Cast it as a sorcery on a later turn without paying its mana cost. Plot only as a sorcery.)
  Kessig Flamebreather {1}{R} — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Kessig Flamebreather deals 1 damage to each opponent.
  Lava Dart {R} — Lava Dart deals 1 damage to any target.\nFlashback—Sacrifice a Mountain. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
  Lightning Bolt {R} — Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
  Mountain no cost — ({T}: Add {R}.)
  Sneaky Snacker {U}{B} — Flying\nWhen you draw your third card in a turn, return Sneaky Snacker from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  Voldaren Epicure {R} — When Voldaren Epicure enters, it deals 1 damage to each opponent. Create a Blood token. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
